maturity_scale.label: Initial
maturity_scale.operational_reading: Capability is ad-hoc, unmeasured, or heavily dependent on heroic individual efforts.

maturity_scale.label: Managed
maturity_scale.operational_reading: Capability exists with baseline operational controls but lacks automated validation.

maturity_scale.label: Defined
maturity_scale.operational_reading: Capability is formalized, standardized, and consistently enforced enterprise-wide.

maturity_scale.label: Quantitatively Managed
maturity_scale.operational_reading: Capability is industrialised, governed with continuous telemetry, and statistically controlled.

maturity_scale.label: Optimizing
maturity_scale.operational_reading: Capability demonstrates predictive continuous improvement and autonomous self-healing.

working_rules.score_indicator: Media simple de preguntas del indicador
working_rules.score_pillar: Media simple de indicadores aplicables del pilar
working_rules.score_tower: Suma ponderada por pesos normalizados de pilar
working_rules.display_rounding: Mostrar 1 decimal en salida; conservar precision interna para calculo y banda
working_rules.reporting_rule: Mostrar score continuo + banda cualitativa + estado de validacion
working_rules.tobe_default_rule: El TO-BE por defecto se fija en nivel 4 salvo excepcion justificada

purpose: The Core Transactional & Mission-Critical Systems domain encompasses central ledger platforms, high-throughput transaction engines, batch processing workloads, core APIs, and platform modernization roadmaps.

kpis.kpi_name: Operational Procedures & Runbook Governance with Evidential Coverage

questions.question_text: How are standard operating procedures (SOPs) and runbooks governed and validated across core processing platforms?

kpis.kpi_name: Mean Time to Restore (MTTR) on Critical Incidents & Tiered Escalation

questions.question_text: What is the historical MTTR for critical production outages, and how are escalation paths structured?

kpis.kpi_name: Incident Recurrence Suppression & Root-Cause Problem Management

questions.question_text: How are recurring transaction processing incidents tracked, root-caused, and permanently mitigated?

kpis.kpi_name: Key-Person Risk Governance & Knowledge Redundancy Continuity

questions.question_text: How is single-engineer dependency (key-person risk) mitigated through cross-training and documented architecture?

kpis.kpi_name: Change Traceability, Impact Assessment & Multi-Tier Approval Gates

questions.question_text: How are change requests, impact models, and peer approvals audited prior to deployment in core environments?

kpis.kpi_name: Change Success Rate (CSR) & Incident Inducement Minimization

questions.question_text: What is the production change success rate, and what percentage of incidents trace back to deployment failures?

kpis.kpi_name: Automated Rollback Capability & Release Contingency Runbooks

questions.question_text: How are automated rollbacks and version regression plans tested and executed during failed release windows?

kpis.kpi_name: Configuration Control (CMDB Baselines) & Environment Drift Parity

questions.question_text: How is configuration drift prevented between staging, pre-production, and production core environments?

kpis.kpi_name: Batch Window SLA Compliance & Critical Path Scheduling Optimization

questions.question_text: How are nightly batch processing windows, settlement deadlines, and dependency graphs monitored against SLA breaches?

kpis.kpi_name: Capacity Planning, Resource Headroom & Utilization Forecasting

questions.question_text: How are compute, memory, and database headroom forecasted to absorb peak transaction surges?

kpis.kpi_name: End-to-End Performance Observability & Bottleneck Detection

questions.question_text: What real-time monitoring and profiling tools detect query latency, lock contention, and message queue bottlenecks?

kpis.kpi_name: Cost/Capacity Optimization & Unit-Economics Efficiency Control

questions.question_text: How are transaction unit costs, database licensing, and compute consumption optimized to prevent financial waste?

kpis.kpi_name: Interface Governance (API Catalog, Strict Contracts & Versioning)

questions.question_text: How are integration contracts, REST/gRPC/event schemas, and backward-compatibility versioning enforced?

kpis.kpi_name: Integration Resiliency (Retries, Message Queues & Fault-Tolerance)

questions.question_text: What dead-letter queues, idempotent consumers, and circuit breakers protect core systems from downstream partner failures?

kpis.kpi_name: Distributed Tracing & End-to-End Hybrid Transaction Observability

questions.question_text: How are end-to-end transaction traces correlated across modern microservices and legacy transactional engines?

kpis.kpi_name: Enterprise IAM Integration & Authentication Security on Core Systems

questions.question_text: How are modern identity protocols (OAuth 2.0/OIDC) and privileged credential rotation integrated into core platforms?

kpis.kpi_name: Vendor Support Lifecycle, End-of-Life (EoL) & Remediated Roadmaps

questions.question_text: How are third-party software end-of-support deadlines, unsupported operating systems, and technical debt backlogs tracked?

kpis.kpi_name: Target Architecture Evolution & Domain-Driven Decoupling Strategy

questions.question_text: What structured architecture roadmap governs the modular modernization or replacement of monolithic core services?

kpis.kpi_name: Engineering Skills Continuity & Specialized Talent Risk Mitigation

questions.question_text: How are talent scarcity, specialized legacy language competencies, and knowledge succession managed?

kpis.kpi_name: Core Software Licensing Governance & Contractual Optimization

questions.question_text: How are core enterprise software licenses, core-based pricing models, and maintenance contracts audited and optimized?
